```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r,message=FALSE}

BASE_DIR <- path.expand("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision")
MIN_N_ORIG <- 5L

sample_manifest <- tribble(~sample, ~af_dir, ~noaf_dir,
  "S1_ONT_Q17", "af5_samples/sp12_ont_sd17_af5", "no_af_samples/sp12_ont_noaf",
  "S1_PB_Q17", "af5_samples/sp12_pb", "no_af_samples/sp12_pb_noaf",
  "S2_ONT_Q17", "af5_samples/sp7_sd17_af5", "no_af_samples/sp7_noaf",
  "S3_ONT_Q17", "af5_samples/sp8_sd17_af5", "no_af_samples/sp8_noaf",
  "S4_ONT_Q17_HD", "af5_hd/sp21_hd_sd17_af5/post_whitelist_run", "no_af_samples/sp21hd_noaf")
sample_order <- sample_manifest$sample
```

Read-in and classify molecular groups

Use the *complete* IG and TR annotation tables to distinguish nonproductive groups
from groups absent from the noAF AIRR output. 

Retention requires productivity, `n_orig >= 5` and the original downstream AIRR quality filters

```{r}
parse_productive <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(x %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes") ~ TRUE,
            x %in% c("false", "f", "0", "no") ~ FALSE, TRUE ~ NA)
}

read_group_states <- function(run_dir) {
  paths <- file.path(BASE_DIR, run_dir, "airr/tmp", c("ig/ig_db-pass.tsv", "tr/tr_db-pass.tsv"))
  map_dfr(paths, ~ read_tsv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), progress = FALSE)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), group != "", !is.na(locus), locus != "") %>%
    mutate(productive_flag = parse_productive(productive), n_orig = as.integer(n_orig),
           v_region_sequence = str_sub(toupper(sequence), as.integer(v_sequence_start), as.integer(v_sequence_end)),
           passes_locus_qc = !is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus,
           passes_umi_qc = !is.na(umi) & !str_detect(umi, "TTTTTTTTTTT"),
           passes_junction_qc = !is.na(junction) & junction != "" & !str_detect(toupper(junction), "N"),
           passes_v_qc = !is.na(v_region_sequence) & v_region_sequence != "" & !str_detect(v_region_sequence, "N"),
           eligible_n_orig = !is.na(n_orig) & n_orig >= MIN_N_ORIG,
           retained = productive_flag %in% TRUE & eligible_n_orig &
             passes_locus_qc & passes_umi_qc & passes_junction_qc & passes_v_qc) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(present_in_airr = TRUE,
              productive_any = any(productive_flag %in% TRUE),
              nonproductive_any = any(productive_flag %in% FALSE),
              productive_eligible_any = any(productive_flag %in% TRUE & eligible_n_orig),
              retained = any(retained), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(group_status = case_when(
      retained ~ "Retained productive",
      !productive_any & nonproductive_any ~ "Nonproductive",
      !productive_eligible_any ~ "Productive, but N_ORIG <= 4",
      productive_eligible_any & !retained ~ "Productive, but excluded by AIRR QC",
      TRUE ~ "Other AIRR outcome")) %>%
    select(group, present_in_airr, retained, group_status)
}

compare_sample <- function(sample, af_dir, noaf_dir) {
  af <- read_group_states(af_dir) %>% select(group, af_retained = retained)
  noaf <- read_group_states(noaf_dir) %>%
    rename(noaf_present = present_in_airr, noaf_retained = retained, noaf_group_status = group_status)

  full_join(af, noaf, by = "group") %>%
    mutate(sample = .env$sample, af_retained = replace_na(af_retained, FALSE),
           noaf_retained = replace_na(noaf_retained, FALSE), noaf_present = replace_na(noaf_present, FALSE)) %>%
    relocate(sample, group)
}

group_comparison <- pmap_dfr(sample_manifest, compare_sample)
```


--Gain categories

Percentages use the number of retained noAF groups as the denominator.
The plotted gain is the recovery of groups retained only with AF

```{r}
sample_summary <- group_comparison %>% group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(noaf_productive = sum(noaf_retained), af_productive = sum(af_retained), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sample_axis_label = paste0(sample, "\nnoAF ", scales::comma(noaf_productive),
                                   " → AF ", scales::comma(af_productive)))
sample_axis_labels <- setNames(sample_summary$sample_axis_label, sample_summary$sample)

category_levels <- c("Nonproductive in noAF", "Productive in noAF, excluded from Fig. 4c",
                     "No corresponding noAF AIRR record", "Other noAF outcome")

gain_plot_data <- group_comparison %>% filter(af_retained, !noaf_retained) %>%
  mutate(plot_category = case_when(
    !noaf_present ~ "No corresponding noAF AIRR record",
    noaf_group_status == "Nonproductive" ~ "Nonproductive in noAF",
    noaf_group_status %in% c("Productive, but N_ORIG <= 4", "Productive, but excluded by AIRR QC") ~
      "Productive in noAF, excluded from Fig. 4c",
    TRUE ~ "Other noAF outcome")) %>%
  count(sample, plot_category, name = "n_groups") %>%
  left_join(sample_summary %>% select(sample, noaf_productive), by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n_groups / noaf_productive,
         percent_label = if_else(percent >= 2.5, scales::number(percent, accuracy = 0.1, suffix = "%"), ""),
         plot_category = factor(plot_category, levels = category_levels),
         sample = factor(sample, levels = rev(sample_order)))

turnover_colors <- c("Nonproductive in noAF" = "#8BD17C",
                     "Productive in noAF, excluded from Fig. 4c" = "#36A567",
                     "No corresponding noAF AIRR record" = "#087F5B", "Other noAF outcome" = "#66C2A4")

# Preserve the original legend: "Ambiguous" includes QC and group-size exclusions.
legend_labels <- c("Nonproductive in noAF" = "Non-prod. in noAF",
                   "Productive in noAF, excluded from Fig. 4c" = "Ambiguous in noAF",
                   "No corresponding noAF AIRR record" = "Not in noAF output")
legend_breaks <- names(legend_labels)[names(legend_labels) %in% as.character(gain_plot_data$plot_category)]
```


plot figure
```{r, fig.width=8.2, fig.height=3.6}
p_af_noaf_categories <- ggplot(gain_plot_data, aes(x = percent, y = sample, fill = plot_category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent_label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.5, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = turnover_colors, breaks = legend_breaks, labels = legend_labels[legend_breaks], drop = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(5), labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1, suffix = "%"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = sample_axis_labels, expand = expansion(add = c(0.12, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "AF-specific gain relative to noAF (%)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey85"),
        panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(lineheight = 0.9),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"), plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

p_af_noaf_categories
```
